metadata.question: Was there more snow water equivalent in a 30 mile radius around Kabul, Afghanistan in February 2018 in comparison to February 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Kabul, Afghanistan (~34.5553°N, 69.2075°E) - Time: February 2017 vs February 2018 - Collection: NASA's MODIS Snow Cover products (MOD10A1/MYD10A1) have NDSI_Snow_Cover band, but for Snow Water Equivalent (SWE), I should use Terra Climate or NSIDC products - Best option: MODIS/006/MOD10A1 has NDSI_Snow_Cover, but for SWE specifically, I need NSIDC/FLDAS or TerraClimate doesn't have SWE - Actually, for SWE: "NASA/FLDAS/NOAH01/C/GL/M/V001" has SWE_inst (Snow Water Equivalent) - FLDAS is monthly, which is perfect for February comparisons 2. Masking strategy: - FLDAS SWE data doesn't require cloud masking - Just need to extract and sum/average the SWE values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid Zero (B): SWE in 2018 is less than or equal to 2017 (legitimate comparison) - Yes (A): SWE in 2018 is greater than 2017 - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: After processing, no valid pixels - C3: Result is None/NaN/invalid ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const kabul = ee.Geometry.Point([69.2075, 34.5553]); const radius = 30 * 1609.34; // 30 miles to meters const aoi = kabul.buffer(radius); // 2. Data Acquisition const fldas = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/FLDAS/NOAH01/C/GL/M/V001'); // February 2017 const col2017 = fldas .filterDate('2017-02-01', '2017-03-01') .filterBounds(aoi) .select('SWE_inst'); // February 2018 const col2018 = fldas .filterDate('2018-02-01', '2018-03-01') .filterBounds(aoi) .select('SWE_inst'); const size2017 = await col2017.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = await col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2018 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get mean SWE for each period const swe2017 = col2017.mean(); const swe2018 = col2018.mean(); // Calculate statistics const stats2017 = await swe2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: aoi, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2018 = await swe2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: aoi, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2017 = stats2017['SWE_inst_mean']; const count2017 = stats2017['SWE_inst_count']; const mean2018 = stats2018['SWE_inst_mean']; const count2018 = stats2018['SWE_inst_count']; console.log(`2017 SWE: ${mean2017} kg/m² (Pixels: ${count2017})`); console.log(`2018 SWE: ${mean2018} kg/m² (Pixels: ${count2018})`); // 4. Validation if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean2017 === null || mean2017 === undefined || mean2018 === null || mean2018 === undefined || isNaN(mean2017) || isNaN(mean2018)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final Answer if (mean2018 > mean2017) { console.log("February 2018 had more SWE than February 2017."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("February 2018 did not have more SWE than February 2017."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```

<answer>B</answer>
